text: Certification requirements that compel directors and officers to certify compliance with a CIA's provisions lower the procedural and enforcement hurdles for pursuing increased sanctions against noncompliant companies.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Elizabeth R. Malay, The Role of Corporate Integrity Agreements in the Expansion of Fiduciary Duties (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2317580

isBasedOn.name: The Role of Corporate Integrity Agreements in the Expansion of Fiduciary Duties

abstract: Certification requirements in CIAs, which require directors and officers to certify compliance with the CIA's provisions, can lower procedural and enforcement hurdles.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: CIAs containing board and officer certification requirements
